text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- In a cliffhanger vote, Portugal's parliament rejected a left-wing bid to liberalise abortion that would have virtually allowed it on demand in the first 12 weeks of pregnancy.
- An Oporto court will try cork businessman Americo Amorim on corruption charges.
- Portuguese inflation will fall more quickly from April, the Bank of Portugal said in its latest monthly report.
- Ship repairer Lisnave to reduce its capital drastically.
- Deutsche Telekom and France Telecom will be strategic partners of Portugal Telecom via Global One, the paper learned.
- Portuguese construction firm Teixeira Duarte may have agreed to buy another Portuguese construction firm Soares da Costa.
